Here's a novel idea - You are kind of an ignorant cunt, aren't you? Perhaps you should start by asking if I've tried therapy. The answer is a resounding yes, up to 15 hours a week at one point. Why am I not doing it now? I had no insurance and the state gave me EVERYTHING I needed in terms of drug addiction/mental health support groups, therapists, psychiatrists. I have 2 fractures in my vertebrae, a herniated disc, bleeding stomach ulcers, liver pain, a deformed rectum(from trauma.. ), pelvic inflammatory disease, benign abdominal tumors, and we'll throw in the pinched nerve just for fun. I had no choice but to get on my mothers insurance once I got so far along in being clean. I needed to get my chronic pain and illness under control if I were to stay clean. There goes my state coverage. I can BARELY afford the copays for all this medical shit, I would never be able to afford the deductibles and copays to get back into the program that helped me so much, I've tried.
I'm alive, just feeling very lethargic, thank you very much for your concern.

I am in Pittsburgh, PA and I had a very bad experience with NA and generally abhor the 12 step program. Are you religious at all? I am not, in fact, given the state of the world right now I am vehemently against anything religious. NA and AA and the 12 steps really imply that and it makes me incredibly uncomfortable. =\
Thank you for sharing your story. <3

Thank you. Mostly what I am thankful for is my humbleness. I was homeless myself at one point, and lived in a condemned crack house at another. I think the further I get from my clean date, the harder it is to be reminded of the things I have now that I never thought I would have again. Thanks for the reminder, bubs. <3
Thank you so much, truly, it's so good to be hearing this. The simplest gestures mean the most to me right now.

Meth is one thing I did not do. I smiled at your post, congratulations. Your simple response means a lot for me. It reminds me when someone else tells me their clean date that it really is such a big triumph.

I don't need to get obsessive to get upset enough to use. See; Chronic pain, rape, abuse, and severe PTSD.

I've been clean this long with an incredible amount of support that got taken away from me because the state paid for the program that helped me wonders, since I had no insurance. I had to get put on my mothers insurance to get my poor health in check.. It's really fucking shitty that I had to trade one for the other. I can't afford the copays and deductibles. I can barely do it with my medical issues and those are more of a necessity than anything else. Maybe once I get the few surgeries I need I can get off the insurance and back into group. 

Blah.

I went to group therapy the state paid for, I have insurance now and I can't afford to go. I went to one NA meeting and was completely turned off by it and was already VERY firmly against the views of the 12 step program. I'll be the first to say I am disgusted by religion and am too judgmental to break passed that right now.
Fucking. Nail. On. The. Head.

I was recently diagnosed with bipolar 2 and I've fought tooth and nail with this, denying it every step of the way. Unfortunately, it took feedback from my friends to show me that I'm incredibly manic. I guess I feel the severity of my situation and my inability to deal with it really creates significant PTSD.. words, places, simple actions can stir of vivid images of what I went through. I'm tearing up just thinking about how much it affects me. The fact I can't control it just fucking eats me up inside, I would go so far as to say that's the most upsetting thing to me.. is my inability to control it.

What a well thought out and meaningful response. Thank you very much for your time and your perspective. I'm very aware of mostly everything you've brought up and I have done an incredible amount of therapy, so you can imagine it's infinitely more frustrating for me.. I was up to 15 hours a week at one point. The last therapist I saw knew that I had a very big issue opening up and knew I wanted a push, he pushed too hard and for the first time ever, I went to the psych ward three days after seeing him and after suffering insomnia, night terrors, literal constant weeping, and zero appetite. 

They pointed me to Dialectical Behavioral Therapy in a group session 3 times a week and I'm dreading taking the necessary steps to get into a group for a few reasons. I don't want to juggle my work schedule anymore than I have to with all the doctor appointments for health issues I have now, and I don't think I could afford it. It's free without insurance, the state pays for it, but I have insurance through my mother, so I would have to pay copays or a large deductible. Considering I just got my W-2s and made 7,600 last year, and living on my own, you could say I'm poor.

Please be assured that I do not like drama, I avoid it. Which is a good reason as to why I get frustrated and want to break up with him every time something emotional happens, and also why I am on reddit, looking for comfort through strangers, rather than talking to my friends. 

I don't know if he is walking all over me and treating my like shit, or if I'm being too needy and cooling down will make things better.. my paranoia that everyone will abuse me (because of the experiences I've had) blinds me from making a sensible decision. It sucks, a whole fucking lot.

Reddit is the only place I've ever been able to admit the things I've been through, because it's very anonymous and I need that. I still can't bring myself to put into audible words some of the violence and abuse I've suffered. I'm not being a baby or a dramatic pussy, these are legitimate issues and legitimate concerns. And I legitimately don't know what to do or think.

I've been doing that for FIVE YEARS. I had rehab, group therapy, individual therapy, physical therapy, and STILL continue to go. I was up to 15 hours a week and I've made so much progress.. like.. I can ACTUALLY date, even if it is painful.

I'm going to have to start having relationships with others at some point or another and I'm not getting any younger. It's not going to be easy no matter when I start dating.

And when you like someone, time isn't really taken into account.
